description: This file defines a PHP class for an invocation tag plugin related to ad layers in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for generating ad invocation code, handling plugin options, and creating layer objects based on styles.

classes.name: Plugins_InvocationTags_OxInvocationTags_adlayer
classes.description: A plugin class for handling invocation tags for ad layers, including generating code, options, and layer styles.

methods.name: getNameEN
methods.description: Returns the English name of the plugin.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is allowed based on extra parameters.

methods.name: canGenerate
methods.description: Determines if the plugin has enough data to generate an ad tag.

methods.name: getOptionsList
methods.description: Returns a list of options for the plugin based on current invocation settings.

methods.name: generateInvocationCode
methods.description: Generates the ad invocation code with comments and layer code.

methods.name: getInvocationLayer
methods.description: Factory method to create a layer object based on style.

methods.name: factoryLayer
methods.description: Creates a specific layer object for invocation tags based on style and type.

methods.name: layerstyle
methods.description: Generates HTML for selecting ad layer styles.

methods.name: layercustom
methods.description: Generates HTML for custom layer settings.
